summary: Audit claims briefly, correct unsupported reports, then sustain implementation.
text: Audit recent claimed progress against commits, tests, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Correct unsupported percentages and repeated claims. Keep the audit brief, then resume sustained autonomous implementation across as many unfinished in-scope tasks as possible. Do not substitute auditing or reporting for productive execution. Return with verified overall completion percentage, change, and evidence only when execution is genuinely exhausted.

situation.trigger: The user suspects prior progress reporting does not match delivered changes.
situation.purpose: Challenge unsupported progress claims and demand accountability.

intent.outcome: Audit claims briefly, correct unsupported reports, then sustain implementation.

appropriate_when: Claims of elapsed work and unchanged percentages need scrutiny
not_appropriate_when: No progress claim exists to assess
The user is requesting a new project rather than auditing ongoing work
preconditions: Compare any available claims to actual repository or test evidence

execution.objective: Audit claims briefly, correct unsupported reports, then sustain implementation.

guards_against: Recycled status updates presented as achievement
tradeoffs: The original text expresses concern; it is not itself an explicit implementation directive
Accusations must not substitute for inspecting evidence
